I have played this game a lot. It's kinda nice, though the development time (it was obscenely long for such a simple product) shines through in the form of all the little compromises this developer was forced to make.

When you have a complex network of lines going all over the place you need to be able to shift them to the side a little bit so that they don't overlap each other. It doesn't necessarily do it for you, instead allowing you to tweak which lines are bent which ways. It tries to prevent you from crossing tracks but it isn't that hard to do. Just attach two lines through a station that cross eachother and then detatch them from the station. It's so trivial to cheese the game in this way it may as well just let you do it.

The game bugs me for ultimately not being as 'minimalist' as it seems, it's a bit convoluted.
